description: Create a new lead list scoped to the request's app. Use this when the user wants to organise leads into a named bucket (e.g. 'Q4 Targets', 'Hot Founders'). The new list starts empty; populate it later via approve_leads with action='approve' and the new list_id, or by editing the list manually. Over MCP: call this tool once, without confirmation_token. It runs right away and returns the result.

description.description: Optional one-sentence description of what the list is for

name.description: Display name for the list (1-100 chars)

name: create_list
